name: Space Warping (Log+Warp)
definition: Warps 3D space towards the view cell center using radial distortion to bring background closer for positional encoding, dampening high frequencies in the background while preserving foreground detail.
summary: Space Warping (Log+Warp) is a positional encoding strategy that warps 3D space to dampen high-frequency background details while preserving foreground accuracy, distinguished by its inverse-square-root warp ensuring consistent sample locations across viewpoints.
